_meta.why: Nasdaq's economic calendar placed the July 2026 FOMC decision on 2026-07-30, but the Fed's own calendar schedules that meeting for July 28-29, so the decision lands on the 29th. A one-day error on the single most market-moving event of the month is worse than any other miss this bot can make, so FOMC dates come from the Fed directly rather than the aggregator.
_meta.meeting_dates_are_two_day: The decision is always announced on the SECOND day at 14:00 ET, with the press conference at 14:30 ET. Only that second day is listed below.
_meta.maintenance: Static — the Fed publishes the next year's dates each summer. Update this file annually; entries for past years are harmless but useless. If a year is missing entirely the bot silently falls back to whatever Nasdaq reports, which is the pre-existing behaviour.
_meta.sep_note: `sep: true` marks meetings that also publish a Summary of Economic Projections (the dot plot), which tends to move markets more than a statement alone.
